verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUKAMA ggwe ngabo yaffe,
Ggwe musana gw'ensi;
Ggwe wekka okeesa-obudde
Era ggwe-obuzibya.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tuwaayo gy'oli ssadddaaka-,
Ey'okwebaza kwaffe;
Era tusaba-otukuume
Okuzibya obudde.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Tusonyiwe bye tusobya,
ffe-abaana b'abantu;
Tuma Omwoyo-ow'ekisa
Ajje mu nda zaffe.
